comment: Nuisance groups for the uncertainty breakdown (docs/BREAKDOWN.md). The array order IS the cumulative freeze order: scan i freezes groups[0..i]. Whatever still floats after the last group is the residual 'stat' component -- that deliberately includes the autoMCStats prop_bin parameters, which text2workspace creates and which therefore cannot be named in a datacard group line. The classification must be exhaustive: an unmatched nuisance is an error, not a catch-all, so a new systematic family surfaces instead of being absorbed silently.
